dice.node.roll.desc: Rolls dice when another node reads its value. Connect it to a Skill Check.
dice.node.check.desc: Compares a roll with a difficulty and continues through Success or Failure.
dice.prop.modifier.desc: Optional: a number variable added to the roll (e.g. courage).
dice.prop.resultVar.desc: Optional: a number variable that receives the roll.
dice.issue.dc: The difficulty is higher than any roll can reach.
